page.overview:
Who is Ao Qin?

Ao Qin belongs to Journey to the West. The is the Dragon King of the South Sea.

Ao Qin and the other Dragon Kings were summoned by Ao Guang when Sun Wukong demanded to be given a new set of clothes. Ao Qin immediately wanted to kill Sun Wukong, but Ao Run convinced him that Sun Wukong was too powerful, and that they sound comply with his demands, then alert Heaven to arrest him.

Ao Qin gave Sun Wukong his Phoenix Feather Cap.
